import sys, time, threading, yaml
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert\(0, '.'\)
from src.api.ib_connector import IBClient
from ibapi.contract import Contract

cfg = yaml.safe_load\(open\('src/config/config.yaml'\)\)
cfg['api']['client_id'] = 20

ib = IBClient\(cfg\)
ok = ib.connect_and_run\(\)
if not ok: sys.exit\(1\)
time.sleep\(2\)
ib.reqMarketDataType\(4\)

# Build just 3 contracts
contracts = []
for strike in [190.0, 195.0, 200.0]:
    c = Contract\(\)
    c.symbol='NVDA'; c.secType='OPT'; c.exchange='SMART'; c.currency='USD'
    c.lastTradeDateOrContractMonth='20260320'; c.strike=strike; c.right='C'; c.multiplier='100'
    contracts.append\(c\)

timed_out = {}
snapshot_timeout = 15.0

# Phase 1: fire all requests
print\('Phase 1: firing requests...'\)
batch_state = []
for contract in contracts:
    req_id = ib._get_next_req_id\(\)
    event = threading.Event\(\)
    with ib._lock:
        ib._mktdata_results[req_id] = {'bid': None, 'ask': None, 'last': None, 'volume': 0, 'open_interest': 0, 'iv': None, 'delta': None, 'gamma': None, 'vega': None, 'theta': None, 'und_price': None}
        ib._mktdata_events[req_id] = event
    ib.reqMktData\(req_id, contract, '', True, False, []\)
    batch_state.append\(\(req_id, event, contract\)\)
    print\(f'  Fired req_id={req_id} for {contract.strike}C'\)

print\('Phase 2: starting wait threads...'\)
def _wait\(req_id, ev\):
    print\(f'  Thread {req_id}: waiting...'\)
    result = ev.wait\(timeout=snapshot_timeout\)
    timed_out[req_id] = not result
    print\(f'  Thread {req_id}: done \(timed_out={not result}\)'\)

wait_threads = [threading.Thread\(target=_wait, args=\(rid, ev\), daemon=True\) for rid, ev, _ in batch_state]
for t in wait_threads: t.start\(\)
print\(f'  Started {len\(wait_threads\)} threads, waiting...'\)
t0 = time.time\(\)
for t in wait_threads: t.join\(timeout=snapshot_timeout + 2\)
print\(f'  All joined in {time.time\(\)-t0:.1f}s, timed_out={timed_out}'\)

# Phase 3: collect results
print\('Phase 3: collecting results...'\)
for req_id, _ev, contract in batch_state:
    with ib._lock:
        data = ib._mktdata_results.pop\(req_id, {}\)
        ib._mktdata_events.pop\(req_id, None\)
    iv = data.get\('iv'\)
    print\(f'  {contract.strike}C: iv={iv}'\)

ib.disconnect\(\)
print\('Done.'\)
" 2>&1)
